firstRoundFindings: theory: Qualify facts[1] so its displayed-price shortcuts apply only to a price wholly subject to $10\%$ GST. The booklet explicitly includes GST-free items and mixed receipts (Percentages Problems, lines 2124–2176), for which dividing the entire displayed total by $11$ does not give its GST. In theory.steps[0–2], restore missing spaces around the embedded numbers and percentages and put mathematical expressions in inline maths; strings such as 'is100%', 'Find10%' and 'by100' currently run words and numbers together.
summary: Qualified the displayed-price GST shortcuts to apply only to prices wholly subject to $10\%$ GST, including guidance for mixed receipts. Restored spaces and inline maths in theory.steps[0–2]; all worked examples, practice items and quiz questions remain unchanged, with no removals.
reviewSummary: The theory matches the booklet’s GST, percentage profit or loss and reverse-profit methods, and all five worked examples have correct calculations and supported question types. No repairs or removals are required within the requested theory-only scope.
